    Vertex groups of free groupoids are free #

    The last step of Lemma 4.2 (lem:mesh-walk-free): "Contracting spanning trees gives a graph. Its edges outside a spanning tree freely generate the fundamental group." Mathlib proves this for a connected free groupoid (IsFreeGroupoid.endIsFreeOfConnectedFree, by a spanning tree). Here the free groupoid on any quiver is shown to be free in Mathlib's sense, and the vertex group at X₀ is identified with the vertex group of the free groupoid on the connected component of X₀.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
